title: Explain KV caching in three sentences.

messages.content: Explain KV caching in three sentences.

KV caching is a data management method used by smart home devices to reduce network bandwidth usage by caching data. It is particularly beneficial for smart devices, such as thermostats, which can preferentially cache data over traditional devices. This caching technique allows the device to save bandwidth by leveraging the energy-saving features of smart devices, such as energy efficiency, thereby reducing the amount of data transmitted over the network.
